title: Exact Inventory Evidence Manifest Resolution
selectedSlice: validated manifest to exact persisted evidence resolution only
purpose: Resolve every exact production-batch and movement identity in one canonical FOOD-006C manifest through FOOD-006D exact persisted reads without yet projecting recorded balances.
rules: The caller-supplied FOOD-006C manifest is canonically validated before storage access.
An invalid manifest returns invalid and performs no database reads.
Every manifest production-batch identity is read through FOOD-006D exact persisted batch resolution.
Every manifest movement identity is read through FOOD-006D exact persisted movement resolution.
A missing exact batch or movement returns not-found for the whole manifest.
Any storage failure aborts the whole resolution with no partial evidence result.
An impossible invalid outcome from a canonically validated exact selector fails closed as storage-failure.
Every resolved batch must exactly match its manifest batch ID and version.
Every resolved batch SKU must exactly equal the manifest SKU ID and version.
Every resolved movement must exactly match the requested movement ID.
Every resolved movement must bind the exact manifest batch ID and version.
Every resolved movement SKU must exactly equal the manifest SKU ID and version.
The canonical FOOD-006C manifest remains the supplied provenance object and is not reinterpreted.
Empty manifest batch collections resolve successfully with an empty evidence collection.
Resolved evidence ordering follows the canonical manifest ordering.
Resolved evidence is deeply frozen and detached.
No FOOD-005Z batch recorded-balance projection occurs.
No FOOD-006A exact-SKU balance aggregation occurs.
No evidence completeness or database cutoff is established.
No authoritative current quantity-on-hand is established.
No reservation, availability, capacity, checkout, payment, fulfillment or sale authority is established.
No writes occur.
No migration definition changes or migration execution occur.
deferred: FOOD-005Z projection over resolved batches and movements.
FOOD-006A aggregation of resolved batch recorded balances.
Database cutoff or point-in-time snapshot provenance.
